variant: C: Listing publication, state, and authorization

domain_invariants.requirement: All resource ids are immutable positive integers; non-positive path and referenced ids are treated as not found.
Properties have title 5..160, address 5..200, price_cents 1000..2000000000, property_type enum, and creator agent.
Agents have unique email, license_code, and active boolean.
Listings reference one property and have DRAFT, PUBLISHED, UNPUBLISHED, ARCHIVED, REJECTED state and unique public_slug ^[a-z0-9-]{8,120}$ when published.
Only creator agent or admin edits listing; only admin rejects; PUBLISHED listing projection is public.
Listing transitions are DRAFT to PUBLISHED, REJECTED, ARCHIVED; PUBLISHED to UNPUBLISHED, ARCHIVED; UNPUBLISHED to PUBLISHED, ARCHIVED.
Publishing requires complete property; archiving retains listing history and never deletes property.
All lists use deterministic ascending immutable id pagination with limit 1..100 default 20 and after_id greater than zero, returning items and nullable next_after_id after filters.

seed_data: Roles are user and admin. GET /health is public; every other route requires a valid non-expired local Bearer session and is deny-by-default.
JSON writes require application/json; malformed JSON is 400, wrong media type is 415, and valid JSON violating declared fields is 422.
The API is local and deterministic with no network, filesystem, upload, or external service. 503 and 500 leave all persistent state unchanged.

apis.formal_requirement: The system shall expose GET /health publicly with no authorization, accepting no input; it shall validate local persistence availability, probe only local persistence, make no persistent change, and emit only 200, or 503.
